original_question: Jerry nwere ọdọ mmiri abụọ, ha abụọ nwere oghere na-ehipu mmiri ọ dịka galọn anọ/nkeji. Nkeji anọ gaara aga, ọdọ mmiri nke buru ibu nwere mmiri ugboro abụọ n'ịhe ọdọ mmiri nke obere nwere. Ugbu a ọdọ mmiri nke buru ibu nwere mmiri ugboro anọ n'ịhe dị n'ọdọ mmiri nke obere. Kedụ mmiri ole nọ n'ọdọ mmiri nke obere?

Nkeji {num_digit_2, 4} gaara aga, ọdọ mmiri nke buru ibu nwere mmiri ugboro {num_text_1, ugboro abụọ} n'ịhe ọdọ mmiri nke obere nwere.
